definitions.explanation: Fifty percent of the original price. Often seen on sale items and discounted products.

examples.english: I bought it at half price.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}{前|まえ}は{弁当|べんとう}が{半額|はんがく}になる。
examples.english: Bento boxes become half price before closing time.

examples.japanese: {半額|はんがく}セールで{服|ふく}を{買|か}いすぎてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up buying too many clothes at the half-price sale.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半額|はんがく}で{買|か}う: to buy at half price
- {半額|はんがく}セール: half-price sale
- {半額|はんがく}シール: half-price sticker

USAGE NOTE:
Supermarkets often put {半額|はんがく} stickers on food items near closing time to reduce waste.

RELATED:
- {割引|わりびき}: discount
- {値下|ねさ}げ: price reduction
- セール: sale
